name: figma-plugin
description: Deep Figma design capabilities on top of a local native execution and multi-window routing kernel.

interface.longDescription: Connect agents to local Figma Design, FigJam, or Slides windows through a native execution + typed export kernel, then apply deep Figma Skills for design craft, reusable components/prototypes, design systems, cross-file design reuse/migration, verification, and design/code translation.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose the local Figma connection and give the exact next action.
Design or revise this Figma screen with existing components, tokens, and verified readback.
Translate or synchronize this design across Figma files and production code without duplicating source truth.
